# Test FMuHiSSE (tutorial)

```{r fig.asp=1}
pars <- c(.1,  .15,  .2,  # lambda 1, 2, 3
          .03, .045, .06, # mu 1, 2, 3
          .05, 0,         # q12, q13
          .05, .05,       # q21, q23
          0,   .05)       # q31, q32
set.seed(2)
phy <- NULL
while( is.null( phy ) ){
    phy <- tree.musse(pars, 30, x0=1, include.extinct=TRUE)
}
plot(phy) ; axisPhylo()
```


```{r fig.asp=1}
k.samples <- data.frame(taxon1="sp20", taxon2="sp14", timefrompresent=8.54554, 
                        state1=0, state2=1, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)

phy.k <- hisse:::AddKNodes(phy, k.samples)
fix.type <- hisse:::GetKSampleMRCA(phy.k, k.samples)
nb.tip <- Ntip(phy.k)
nb.node <- phy.k$Nnode
gen <- hisse:::FindGenerations(phy.k)

states <- phy$tip.state
states <- data.frame(phy$tip.state, phy$tip.state, row.names=names(phy$tip.state))
states <- states[phy$tip.label,]
states.trans <- states
for(i in 1:Ntip(phy)){
    if(states[i,1] == 1){
        states.trans[i,1] = 0
        states.trans[i,2] = 0
    }
    if(states[i,1] == 2){
        states.trans[i,1] = 0
        states.trans[i,2] = 1
    }
    if(states[i,1] == 3){
        states.trans[i,1] = 1
        states.trans[i,2] = 0
    }
}

data <- data.frame(taxon=names(phy$tip.state), 
                   states.trans[,1], states.trans[,2], stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
data
```

```{r}
turnover <- c(1,2,3,0, 4,5,6,0)
extinction.fraction <- c(1,1,1,0, 1,1,1,0)
trans.rate <- TransMatMakerMuHiSSE(hidden.traits=1)
trans.rate.mod <- ParDrop(trans.rate, c(4,6,7,8,12,14,15,16))

pp <- MuHiSSE(phy=phy, data, f=c(1,1,1,0), turnover=turnover, eps=extinction.fraction, 
              trans.rate=trans.rate.mod, k.samples=k.samples, hidden.states=T, includes.fossils=TRUE)
pp
```

```{r fig.asp=1}
margin.test <- MarginReconMuHiSSE(phy=phy, data=data, f=c(1,1,1,0), pars=pp$solution, hidden.states=1, includes.fossils=TRUE, k.samples=k.samples)
plot.muhisse.states(margin.test, legend.cex=0.7, legend.kernel = "gaussian")
```

```{r}
load("../../3-Data_processed/Morphospecies_phylogenies/SpinoseOnly_sampledAncestors.RData")
```

```{r fig.width=15, fig.asp=0.6}
par(mfrow=c(1,3))
for (tree_name in c("Phylo_NonSpinoseOnly_sampledAncestors",
                    "Phylo_SpinoseOnly_sampledAncestors",
                    "Phylo_MixedSpinose_sampledAncestors")) {
  tree       <- get(tree_name)
  group_name <- gsub("^Phylo_|_sampledAncestors$", "", tree_name)
  
  # Match functional data to the tree tip order.
  tree_data <- functional_df[match(tree$tip.species, functional_df$Morphospecies), ]
  if (any(is.na(tree_data$Morphospecies))) {
    warning("Some species in the tree were not found in functional_df for model: ", group_name)
  }
  
  tree_data <- tree_data %>%
  mutate(depth = factor(case_when(
    eco == "Asymbiotic SML" ~ "Surface",
    eco == "High latitude" ~ "Other",
    eco == "High productivity" ~ "Other",
    eco == "Sub-thermocline" ~ "Sub-thermocline",
    eco == "Symbiotic SML" ~ "Surface",
    eco == "Thermocline" ~ "Thermocline"
  ), levels = c("Surface", "Thermocline", "Sub-thermocline", "Other")))
  
  # -------------------------------
  # Plot tree colored by water depths
  depth_levels <- levels(tree_data$depth)
  depth_colors <- setNames(c("#009E73", "#56B4E9", "blue4", "black"), depth_levels)
  tip_colors_depth <- depth_colors[as.character(tree_data$depth)]
  plot(tree, tip.color = tip_colors_depth, main = group_name, cex = 0.8) ; axisPhylo()
  legend("topright", legend = names(depth_colors), fill = depth_colors, cex = 1, title = "Depth", title.cex = 0.8)
}
```

```{r fig.width=17, fig.asp=0.6}
# Define depth mapping and colours
eco2depth <- function(x) {
  out <- ifelse(x %in% c("Symbiotic SML", "Asymbiotic SML"), "Surface",
         ifelse(x == "Thermocline", "Thermocline",
         ifelse(x == "Sub-thermocline", "Sub-thermocline",
         ifelse(x %in% c("High latitude", "High productivity"), "Other", NA))))
  factor(out, levels = c("Surface", "Thermocline", "Sub-thermocline", "Other", "Unknown"))
}

depth_cols <- c(Surface = "green3",
                Thermocline = "skyblue",
                `Sub-thermocline` = "blue4",
                Other = "white",
                Unknown = "yellow2")

par(mfrow = c(1, 3))

for (tree_name in c("Phylo_NonSpinoseOnly_sampledAncestors",
                    "Phylo_SpinoseOnly_sampledAncestors",
                    "Phylo_MixedSpinose_sampledAncestors")) {

  tree       <- get(tree_name)
  group_name <- gsub("^Phylo_|_sampledAncestors$", "", tree_name)

  ## Map tips and nodes to eco → depth
  tip_depth <- eco2depth(functional_df$eco[match(tree$tip.species, functional_df$Morphospecies)])
  tip_depth[is.na(tip_depth)] <- "Unknown"

  node_depth <- eco2depth(functional_df$eco[match(tree$node.species, functional_df$Morphospecies)])
  node_depth[is.na(node_depth)] <- "Unknown"

  ## Plot tree
  plot(tree, show.tip.label = T, main = group_name, cex = 0.8)

  # Add coloured circles for tips
  tiplabels(pch = 21,
            bg  = depth_cols[as.character(tip_depth)],
            cex = 1)

  # Add coloured circles for internal nodes (sampled ancestors)
  nodelabels(pch = 21,
             bg  = depth_cols[as.character(node_depth)],
             cex = 1)

  # Legend
  legend("topright",
         legend = names(depth_cols),
         pt.bg  = depth_cols,
         pch    = 21,
         pt.cex = 1.3,
         bty    = "n",
         title  = "Depth",
         title.col = "black")
  
  # print(tree_name)
  # print(unique(tree$tip.species[tip_depth == "Unknown"]))
  # print(unique(tree$node.species[node_depth == "Unknown"]))
  # cat("\n\n")
}
```

## FMuHiSSE analysis

```{r}
## Map ecogroups → observed depth states {1,2,3}
eco_to_obs <- function(x) {
  ifelse(x %in% c("Symbiotic SML", "Asymbiotic SML"), 1L,     # Surface
  ifelse(x == "Thermocline",                          2L,     # Thermocline
  ifelse(x == "Sub-thermocline",                      3L,     # Sub-thermocline
         NA_integer_)))
}

## Encode 3 states into two binary columns
## 1 -> (0,1), 2 -> (0,0), 3 -> (1,0)
## Note: explicit row-wise assignment because `M[idx, ] <- c(a, b)` recycles
## column-major in R and scrambles state assignments when length(idx) > 1.
encode_3_to_2 <- function(s) {
  M <- matrix(NA_integer_, nrow = length(s), ncol = 2)
  i <- !is.na(s) & s == 1; M[i, 1] <- 0L; M[i, 2] <- 1L
  i <- !is.na(s) & s == 2; M[i, 1] <- 0L; M[i, 2] <- 0L
  i <- !is.na(s) & s == 3; M[i, 1] <- 1L; M[i, 2] <- 0L
  M
}
```

```{r}
## --- Extract k.samples from sampled-ancestor nodes and remove them from the tree ---
extract_k_and_collapse <- function(tree, functional_df) {
  # Remove tips with unknown state
  keep <- !is.na(eco_to_obs(functional_df$eco[match(tree$tip.species, functional_df$Morphospecies)]))
  tree <- drop.tip(tree, tree$tip.label[!keep], collapse.singles = F)
  tree$tip.species <- tree$tip.species[tree$tip.label]
  tree$node.species <- tree$node.species[tree$node.label]
  
  tree_labels <- c(tree$tip.label, tree$node.label)
  
  k_nodes <- grep("F", tree$node.label, value = T)
  k_descendants <- sapply(k_nodes, function(k_node){
    k_children <- phangorn::Children(tree, k_node)
    while(any(grepl("F|N", tree_labels[k_children]))){
      if (length(k_children) == 1){
        k_children <- phangorn::Children(tree, k_children)
      }else if (grepl("F|N", tree_labels[k_children])[1]){
        k_children[1] <- phangorn::Children(tree, k_children[1])[[1]]
      }else{
        k_children[2] <- phangorn::Children(tree, k_children[2])[[1]]
      }
    }
    if (length(k_children) == 1){
      c(tree_labels[k_children], tree_labels[k_children])
    }else{
      tree_labels[k_children]
    }
  })
  
  k_samples <- data.frame(k_nodes, t(k_descendants))
  names(k_samples) <- c("node_label", "taxon1", "taxon2")
  
  # Get k-node ages
  all_ages <- paleotree::dateNodes(tree = tree)
  names(all_ages) <- tree_labels
  k_samples$timefrompresent <- all_ages[k_samples$node_label]
  
  # Get depth states
  k_samples$species <- tree$node.species[k_samples$node_label]
  k_samples$eco_state <- eco_to_obs(functional_df$eco[match(k_samples$species, functional_df$Morphospecies)])
  k_samples$state1 <- encode_3_to_2(k_samples$eco_state)[,1]
  k_samples$state2 <- encode_3_to_2(k_samples$eco_state)[,2]
  
  # Remove k-samples with unknown state
  k_samples <- k_samples[!is.na(k_samples$state1),]

  # Remove sampled-ancestor nodes (merge their two incident edges)
  phy_clean <- ape::collapse.singles(tree)

  list(phy = phy_clean, k.samples = k_samples)
}

Phylo_NonSpinoseOnly_sampledAncestors.k <- extract_k_and_collapse(Phylo_NonSpinoseOnly_sampledAncestors, functional_df)
Phylo_SpinoseOnly_sampledAncestors.k <- extract_k_and_collapse(Phylo_SpinoseOnly_sampledAncestors, functional_df)
Phylo_MixedSpinose_sampledAncestors.k <- extract_k_and_collapse(Phylo_MixedSpinose_sampledAncestors, functional_df)
```

```{r}
## Build MuHiSSE data for a given tree
run_muhisse_depth <- function(tree, k.samples, functional_df) {

  # Tip states (numeric 0,1,2)
  obs <- eco_to_obs(functional_df$eco[match(tree$tip.species, functional_df$Morphospecies)])

  # Data frame for hisse
  X <- encode_3_to_2(obs)
  dat <- data.frame(taxon = tree$tip.label,
                    stateA = X[,1],
                    stateB = X[,2],
                    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                    row.names = tree$tip.label)

  # Transition matrix with one hidden trait
  # trans <- TransMatMakerMuHiSSE(hidden.traits = 1)              # 3 observed × 2 hidden = 6 states
  trans <- TransMatMakerMuHiSSE(hidden.traits = 1, make.null = T)              # 3 observed × 2 hidden = 6 states
  trans.mod <- ParDrop(trans, c(4,6,7,8,12,14,15,16))

  # Optionally collapse impossible transitions here with ParDrop()

  # Parameter index vectors
  n.full   <- nrow(trans.mod)
  turnover <- c(1,2,3,0, 4,5,6,0)              # free turnover per state
  # turnover <- c(1,2,3,0, 1,2,3,0)              # shared across hidden states
  # turnover <- c(1,1,1,0, 1,1,1,0)              # shared
  extinction.fraction <- c(1,2,3,0, 4,5,6,0)   # free extinction fraction per state
  # extinction.fraction <- c(1,2,3,0, 1,2,3,0)   # shared across hidden states
  # extinction.fraction <- c(1,1,1,0, 1,1,1,0)   # shared

  fit <- MuHiSSE(phy = tree,
                 data = dat,
                 f = c(1,1,1,0),
                 turnover = turnover, turnover.upper = 10,
                 eps = extinction.fraction, eps.upper = 2,
                 trans.rate = trans.mod,
                 k.samples = k.samples[c("taxon1", "taxon2", "timefrompresent", "state1", "state2")],
                 hidden.states = TRUE,
                 includes.fossils = TRUE, 
                 root.p = c(0.5, 0, 0, 0, 0.5, 0, 0, 0), # The root state is Thermocline for all clades
                 ode.eps = 1e-8)
  
  fit$tree <- tree
  fit$dat <- dat
  fit$k.samples <- k.samples[c("taxon1", "taxon2", "timefrompresent", "state1", "state2")]
  fit
}

clade_inputs <- list(
  Mixed      = Phylo_MixedSpinose_sampledAncestors.k,
  NonSpinose = Phylo_NonSpinoseOnly_sampledAncestors.k,
  Spinose    = Phylo_SpinoseOnly_sampledAncestors.k
)

fits <- list()
for (clade in names(clade_inputs)) {
  fit_file <- sprintf("FMuHiSSE_fit_%s.RData", clade)
  if (file.exists(fit_file)) {
    message("Loading existing fit for ", clade, " from ", fit_file)
    fit_obj <- get(load(fit_file))
  } else {
    message("Fitting ", clade, "...")
    t0 <- Sys.time()
    fit_obj <- run_muhisse_depth(clade_inputs[[clade]]$phy, clade_inputs[[clade]]$k.samples, functional_df)
    message("  done in ", format(Sys.time() - t0, digits = 3))
    assign(paste0("fit_", clade), fit_obj)
    save(list = paste0("fit_", clade), file = fit_file)
  }
  fits[[clade]] <- fit_obj
}
```

```{r fig.width=15}
}
```
